title: GOOSE-M2F: Adapting Mask2Former for High-Fidelity, Long-Tailed Fine-Grained Semantic Segmentation in Unstructured Outdoor Terrain
mechanism: Auxiliary per-pixel CE head (weight 0.4, removed at inference) beside the Mask2Former matching loss so rare/tiny classes get dense gradient; plus 200 queries, distribution-balanced loss, rare-class copy-paste.
evidence: R: ablation on GOOSE val 54.6 -> 57.1 (+200 queries) -> 60.4 (+refinement) -> 63.8 (+3.4 aux head) -> 67.5 (balanced loss + rare copy-paste); 3rd place 70.08 composite mIoU; Swin-L; ablation table has internal inconsistencies.
adaptation: Bolt the dense head onto any mask classifier we run (EoMT/M2F) at full resolution, not 1/4, supervised with our CE + soft Dice on crack and inactive; class-balanced weights only on weak other classes (gridline, splice, edge_dark, material). S: in semantic mode each present class is one target so the 'zero gradient' claim is shaky; the head is cheap insurance for 0.19%-pixel crack.
min_experiment: Within the M2F/EoMT runs: arm with dense aux head vs same model without; metrics crack IoU, relF1@2, splice IoU, mIoU_rob; kill if crack IoU gain < 0.012 and splice stays 0.
prior_overlap: none; long-tail and auxiliary losses on mask classifiers untested.

alt_notes.adaptation: Add a full-res dense head with our CE + Dice on crack and inactive to any mask classifier (EoMT, M2F); copy-paste inactive regions together with their bounding cracks rather than cracks alone.
alt_notes.min_experiment: M2F Swin-B 512 arm A (plain) vs arm B (+dense aux head + high-res conv branch), baseline house; metrics crack relF1@2, inactive IoU, splice/material/edge_dark IoU, mIoU_rob; kill B if mIoU_rob < house - 0.01 and inactive IoU not above house.
